subject.title: fix(auth): count token-type profiles in provider health status rollup

question: Should `models.authStatus` report effective token/setup-token health for OAuth-configured providers when no effective OAuth profile exists?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and well-proven, but it changes the provider-health signal that dashboards and operator alerts may already consume as an OAuth-only status.

options.title: Accept token fallback
options.body: Land the PR with the current OAuth-first, token-second rollup because it matches runtime usability after setup-token migration.

options.title: Keep OAuth-only health
options.body: Pause or redesign this PR if maintainers want the gateway health signal to remain a strict OAuth-login status even for token-backed migrations.

recommendation.title: Accept token fallback
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the current OAuth-first, token-second rollup because it matches runtime usability after setup-token migration.
